notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (product analytics + in-app support widgets). Evaluating Redwood Hosted API as fast path for Q1 feature launch, then Dedicated for production scale & data isolation. Strong cost sensitivity; primary evaluation axis = unit economics for chat & reranking.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Jordan). Product + infra on call (CTO Priya R.). Agreed goals: <300ms p95 chat latency, 80 req/s steady state for EU+NA, and strict data residency for EU customers.
- 2026-01-28: Hosted API demo (Avery). Live demo using saltworks support-bot prompts. Fireflies id ff_20260210_0a9b3c contains transcript.
- 2026-02-10: POC kickoff (hosted API). Provided prompt set (drive doc) and sample traffic profile. Baseline vs in-house: slightly higher latency but better answer diversity.
- 2026-02-18: Security questionnaire returned (drive://redwood/security/saltworks-sq-answers-2026-02-18.xlsx). SOC2 + SSO required before prod.
- 2026-02-22: Pricing sync. Saltworks wants committed pricing for Dedicated once Hosted eval shows 30-40% cost improvement with optimize levers.
- 2026-02-24: Technical deep-dive (SE Avery). Ran preliminary cost-optimization analysis and proposed workshop.

POC / Performance notes:
- Traffic profile: 60% chat (short multi-turn), 25% reranking/semantic-rank (batchable), 15% embeddings for search indexing.
- Latency targets: interactive chat <300ms p95; background rerank throughput target 200 qps during daily peaks.
- Hosted API POC: median latency ~120ms token-step; end-to-end chat p95 ~420ms (need improvement).
- Initial cost snapshot: hosted per-token run ~2.4x current in-house GPU unit cost. Saltworks expects Dedicated to be cheaper if combined with Optimize levers.

Cost-optimization workshop (requested agenda / outputs):
- Workshop goal: concrete plan to hit 30-45% token cost reduction vs hosted baseline, with latency SLOs intact.
- Topics to cover:
  - Batching strategy: identify endpoints/requests that can be batched (reranking, multi-document summarization). Prototype batch sizes and estimate latency vs throughput tradeoffs. Early recommendation: batch size 4-8 for rerank to hit throughput target with p95 < 250ms.
  - KV / prefix caching: share approach for conversational KV caching to cut repeated token generation for common flows (support replies). Estimate 15-25% token saving for chat with frequent repeated prompts.
  - Quantization profiles: test 8-bit (int8) + 4-bit candidate profiles on representative models. Discuss expected quality delta (~1-3% on relevance metrics) and throughput gains (1.8-2.5x).
  - Routing & fallback policy: how to route low-latency traffic to smaller quantized models and heavy generation to larger models; fallback paths during contention.
  - Unit economics walk-through: end-to-end cost per resolved chat, cost per rerank request, and price points for Dedicated reserved capacity. Produce a simple model that maps committed GPU pool size -> monthly unit cost.
  - Measurement plan: key metrics (tokens saved via cache, batching efficiency, tail latency), instrumentation pointers, and Eval prompt set to track quality regressions.

Quotes / call notes:
- "We need something predictable for Q3 pricing — spikes kill our margins." — Priya R., CTO
- "If you can show 30% cost reduction with no material quality loss, we will move to Dedicated commit." — Head of Product

- Deliverables after workshop: concrete batch/caching config, quantization test results on customer prompts, updated Dedicated sizing & commit pricing.
